questionText: How close must price come to a level for the setup to count?
reason: The taught rule is binary - at the level or not applicable. The demonstrated behaviour is graded: ~10 pips short was judged too far, on a pair where 10 pips is small relative to daily range. No source gives a tolerance. This is the clearest case yet in the library of a discretionary filter operating in live trading that appears in none of the instructional sources. **MOGO must not pick a number.**
